PRESIDENTS ORDER 15 OF 1985
SENATE (MEMBERS
FROM THE FEDERAL CAPITAL) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part
I, 6th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that behalf, the
President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Senate (Members from the
Federal Capital) (Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of First
Schedule, P.O. No. 12 of 1973.---In the, Senate (Members from the Federal
Capital) Order, 1973 (P.O. No. 12 of 1973)
for the First Schedule the following shall be substituted, namely:-
